summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of 15,893,817 new ordinary shares with warrants (ABSAs) at €2.33 per ABSA, raising €37M. Each warrant is exercisable at €2.96 per share (25% premium to VWAP) until 30 days after FDA approval of its Lyme disease vaccine or March 31, 2028 (extendable to September 2028). A 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation applies, adjustable up to 19.99% subject to French FDI rules. Jefferies, TD Securities, Stifel, and Van Lanschot Kempen acted as placement agents. The closing is expected May 5, 2026. Proceeds will fund pipeline advancement, commercial growth, and working capital. This equity-linked financing is not a typical special situation category.
